basics.name: Zheyu Wang
basics.label: Research Intern at Tsinghua University
basics.summary: I study generative modeling of physiological signals, with broader interests in NeuroAI, AI for health, and continual learning.

work.name: Tsinghua University
work.summary: Department of Psychological and Cognitive Sciences. Advised by [Liyuan Wang](https://www.pcs.tsinghua.edu.cn/xlxen/info/1010/1773.htm).
highlights: Designed and trained a shared waveform codec and a hierarchical autoregressive model for [physiological signal generation](/projects/physiological-signal-modeling/).
Implemented an encoder and led training and downstream evaluation for [pulse waveform reconstruction from millimeter-wave radar](/projects/radar-pulse-reconstruction/).

work.name: Peking University
work.summary: Worked on the [HeartMuLa music foundation models](/publications/#yang2026heartmula) with Yuexian Zou.
highlights: Built data processing and evaluation pipelines and contributed to model training and inference.

work.name: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
work.summary: Worked on sub-1-bit LLM quantization with Yike Guo.
highlights: Contributed to the [BTC-LLM](/publications/#gu-etal-2026-btc) architecture, ran baseline experiments, and wrote the experimental section.

work.name: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China
work.summary: Worked on learning with missing modalities with Ruiting Dai.
highlights: Analyzed and visualized experimental results, drew method figures, and contributed to the [γ-CRD](/publications/#dai2025gammacrd) manuscript.
Designed and implemented missing-modality generation methods and ran main experiments and ablations.
